availableCommands.description: General-purpose sub-agent with access to all tools for executing arbitrary tasks

availableCommands.name: context-gatherer
availableCommands.description: Investigates the codebase to answer a specific question about it. Deeply analyzes existing code by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture and abstraction layers, understanding patterns, and documenting dependencies, returning a thorough, direct written analysis that explains how the relevant code works and points to the specific files and lines involved. Use it to understand code before you change it: before designing or implementing a change to code you don't already fully understand, start with context-gatherer so your edits are grounded in how the code actually works. When a task requires understanding code you don't already know, dispatch context-gatherer to do that exploration before running your own searches or reads. Rules: 1. Provide a clear, specific prompt that includes your intent: a detailed task description of the context you need and what you're trying to accomplish. 2. The subagent explores the codebase and returns an analysis of your query 3. Trust the returned results. You may still inspect additional code yourself when you need context beyond what was returned. 4. Reuse existing context-gatherer output for related follow-up questions; do not re-invoke on the same question with different phrasing. 5. For multiple distinct questions, dispatch several context-gatherers in parallel, each targeting a different aspect of the codebase.

availableCommands.name: kirocrew-conductor

Never does the work itself.

availableCommands.name: convert-to-icon
availableCommands.description: Use when turning an image or SVG into icons - favicon, .ico, .icns, iOS and Android app icons - or a raster logo into SVG (provide the image path). Triggers on "convert to icon", "make icons", "favicon", "app icon", "icns", "vectorize logo".

availableCommands.name: copy-rich-text
availableCommands.description: Use when content must be formatted, copied, or made ready to paste into Microsoft Teams, Outlook, or another rich-text app; copy it in the same turn. Triggers on "format for Teams", "Teams-ready", "copy to clipboard", "rich copy".

availableCommands.name: create-note
availableCommands.description: Use when creating BIM notes from Teams messages, articles, videos, meetings, ideas, or inbox items, or adding projects, books, or contacts. Triggers on "take note", "note this", "create a note", "add a zettel", "make meeting minutes".

availableCommands.name: create-prd
availableCommands.description: Use when converting a plan, design doc, brainstorming output, or discovery doc into a structured PRD saved to the backlog. Triggers on "create PRD", "create PRD from plan", "make PRD", "convert to PRD", "save plan as PRD".

availableCommands.name: create-skill

availableCommands.name: debrief-meeting

availableCommands.name: elicit-requirements

  def _write_policy(out: Path, output: bytes) -> None:
    """Inspect the opened inode before truncating; aliases cannot redirect a
    write. Opens nonblocking so a FIFO with no reader refuses instead of
    hanging; refuses up front on a platform without O_NOFOLLOW rather than
    crashing on the attribute lookup."""
    if not hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW"):
        raise ValueError(f"{out}: platform has no O_NOFOLLOW support")
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK
    try:
        fd = os.open(out, flags, 0o666)
    except OSError as error:
        if error.errno == errno.ENXIO:
            raise ValueError(f"{out} has no reader (FIFO)") from error
        raise
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as sink:
        # `fd` is owned by `sink` from here on: any exception below, including
        # one from set_blocking itself, still closes it via this `with` block.
        os.set_blocking(sink.fileno(), True)
        info = os.fstat(sink.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"{out} must be a regular file with one hard link")
        os.ftruncate(sink.fileno(), 0)

  def _write_policy(out: Path, output: bytes) -> None:
    """Inspect the opened inode before truncating; aliases cannot redirect a
    write. Opens nonblocking so a FIFO with no reader refuses instead of
    hanging; refuses up front on a platform without O_NOFOLLOW rather than
    crashing on the attribute lookup."""
    if not hasattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW"):
        raise ValueError(f"{out}: platform has no O_NOFOLLOW support")
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK
    try:
        fd = os.open(out, flags, 0o666)
    except OSError as error:
        if error.errno == errno.ENXIO:
            raise ValueError(f"{out} has no reader (FIFO)") from error
        raise
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as sink:
        # `fd` is owned by `sink` from here on: any exception below, including
        # one from set_blocking itself, still closes it via this `with` block.
        os.set_blocking(sink.fileno(), True)
        info = os.fstat(sink.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise ValueError(f"{out} must be a regular file with one hard link")
        os.ftruncate(sink.fileno(), 0)
        sink.write(output)

"""Owner lease transitions under the controller's existing exclusive lock."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import hmac
import os
import re
import secrets
from pathlib import Path

from . import actors, schema
from .store import StateIOError, StateStore

INTENT_KEYS = {"version", "request", "request_digest", "old_revision",
               "old_state_digest", "old_actor", "old_actors", "old_owner",
               "candidate", "response", "receipt", "credentials"}


def transition(current: dict, request: dict, operator: dict,
               owner: dict | None, layout: actors.PrivateLayout) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(current)
    candidate["revision"] += 1
    candidate["lease_epoch"] += 1
    candidate["actors"] = {operator["actor_id"]: operator}
    candidate["owner"] = None
    result = {"actor_id": operator["actor_id"], "lease_epoch": candidate["lease_epoch"],
              "operator_actor_file": str(layout.actors / "operator.json")}
    if owner is not None:
        candidate["actors"][owner["actor_id"]] = owner
        candidate["owner"] = {"actor_id": owner["actor_id"],
                              "lease_epoch": candidate["lease_epoch"], **request["payload"]}
        result.update(actor_id=owner["actor_id"],
                      actor_file=str(layout.actors / (owner["actor_id"] + ".json")))
    completed = {"ok": True, "revision": candidate["revision"], "result": result,

                 "project_id", "workflow_id", "actor_id", "job_id", "lease_epoch", "payload"}

class ProtocolError(Exception):
    """A fixed, redacted public failure, with its observed revision."""

    try:
        if command == "contract":
            return public_contract()[0]
        if command == "snapshot":
            return snapshot(root)
        return apply(root, request_file, actor_file)
    except ProtocolError as error:
        return response(revision=error.revision, error=error.code)
    except FutureSchemaError:
        return response(error="incompatible_contract")
    except (StateError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, RecursionError):
        return response(error="recovery_required")

            f"state: canonical stored document exceeds {schema.MAX_STATE_BYTES} bytes"

        self,
        path: Path,

        boundary_hook: BoundaryHook | None = None,

        self._path = path
        self._lock_path = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.lock")
        self._backup_path = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.bak")

        self._directory_fd: ContextVar[int] = ContextVar("state_directory_fd")

        return self._path

    def read(self) -> State:

            return self._read_locked()

    def _read_locked(self) -> State:
        return self._decode_state(self._read_bytes(self._path))

    def initialize(self, initial: State) -> State:
        with self._locked(exclusive=True):
            return self._initialize_locked(initial)

    def _initialize_locked(self, initial: State) -> State:
        validated = schema.validate_state(initial)
        if type(validated["revision"]) is not int or validated["revision"] != 0:
            raise StateError("revision: initialization requires revision 0")
        if self._artifact_exists(self._path):
            raise StateExistsError(f"state already exists: {self._path}")
        self._publish_bytes(
            self._path, _canonical_bytes(validated),
            temp_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_TEMP_FSYNCED,
            replaced_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_REPLACED,
            directory_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_DIR_FSYNCED,
            create_only=True,
        )
        return validated

    def transaction(
        self, mutator: Mutator, *, expected_revision: int | None = None,
        publication_guard: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> State:
        with self._locked(exclusive=True):
            return self._transaction_locked(
                mutator, expected_revision=expected_revision,
                publication_guard=publication_guard,
            )

    def _transaction_locked(
        self, mutator: Mutator, *, expected_revision: int | None = None,
        publication_guard: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> State:
        current_raw = self._read_bytes(self._path)
        current = self._decode_state(current_raw)
        self._check_revision(current, expected_revision)
        previous_backup = self._snapshot(self._backup_path)
        candidate = copy.deepcopy(current)
        replacement = mutator(candidate)
        proposed = candidate if replacement is None else copy.deepcopy(replacement)
        if isinstance(proposed, dict):
            proposed["revision"] = current["revision"] + 1
        committed = schema.validate_state(proposed)
        state_bytes = _canonical_bytes(committed)
        if publication_guard is not None:
            publication_guard()

            backup_bytes=current_raw, state_bytes=state_bytes,
            old_state=current_raw, old_backup=previous_backup,
            publication_guard=publication_guard,
        )
        return committed

    def restore(
        self, *, expected_revision: int | None = None,
        precondition: Precondition | None = None,
    ) -> State:
        with self._locked(exclusive=True):
            return self._restore_locked(
                expected_revision=expected_revision, precondition=precondition,
            )

    def _restore_locked(
        self, *, expected_revision: int | None = None,
        precondition: Precondition | None = None,
    ) -> State:
        current_raw = self._read_bytes(self._path)
        current = self._decode_state(current_raw)
        self._check_revision(current, expected_revision)
        backup_raw = self._read_backup()

            restored = self._decode_state(backup_raw)
        except (schema.SchemaError, StateError) as error:

        )

            os.stat("credential-intent.json", dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(),
                    follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        return True

    @contextmanager
    def _locked(self, *, exclusive: bool) -> Iterator[None]:
        directory = descriptor = -1
        token = None
        try:
            directory = os.open(self._path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
            token = self._directory_fd.set(directory)
            self._verify_directory()
            descriptor = self._open_lock()
            fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX if exclusive else fcntl.LOCK_SH)
            self._verify_directory()
            self._verify_open_artifact(self._lock_path, descriptor, "state lock")
            yield
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"state lock failed {self._lock_path}: {error}") from error
        finally:
            if descriptor >= 0:
                try:
                    fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
                finally:
                    os.close(descriptor)
            if token is not None:
                self._directory_fd.reset(token)
            if directory >= 0:
                os.close(directory)

    def _open_lock(self) -> int:
        self._reject_aliased_artifact(self._lock_path, "state lock")
        descriptor = os.open(
            self._lock_path.name, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
            0o600, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(),
        )
        try:
            self._verify_open_artifact(self._lock_path, descriptor, "state lock")
            os.fchmod(descriptor, 0o600)
        except BaseException:
            os.close(descriptor)
            raise
        return descriptor

    def _verify_directory(self) -> None:
        opened = os.fstat(self._directory_fd.get())
        linked = os.stat(self._path.parent)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino):
            raise StateIOError("state directory changed during operation")

    def _check_revision(self, state: State, expected: int | None) -> None:
        if expected is not None and (type(expected) is not int or expected < 0):
            raise StateError("expected revision must be a nonnegative integer")
        if expected is not None and state["revision"] != expected:
            raise RevisionConflictError(
                f"revision conflict: expected {expected}, found {state['revision']}"
            )

    def _read_bytes(self, path: Path) -> bytes:
        descriptor = -1
        try:
            self._reject_aliased_artifact(path, "state artifact")
            descriptor = os.open(
                path.name,
                os.O_RDONLY
                | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
                | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
                | getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0),
                dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(),
            )
            self._verify_open_artifact(path, descriptor, "state artifact")
            chunks: list[bytes] = []
            remaining = schema.MAX_STATE_BYTES + 1
            while remaining > 0:
                chunk = os.read(descriptor, min(remaining, 64 * 1024))
                if not chunk:
                    break
                chunks.append(chunk)
                remaining -= len(chunk)
            raw = b"".join(chunks)
        except OSError as error:
            detail = " is a symlink" if error.errno == errno.ELOOP else f": {error}"
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot read state {path}{detail}") from error

                os.close(descriptor)

        except (
            UnicodeDecodeError,
            ValueError,
        ) as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"invalid state JSON: {error}") from error

                isinstance(version, int)
                and not isinstance(version, bool)
                and version > schema.SCHEMA_VERSION
            ):

                    f"schema_version {version} is newer than {schema.SCHEMA_VERSION}"
                )

        old_backup: bytes | None,

                self._backup_path,
                backup_bytes,
                temp_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_TEMP_FSYNCED,
                replaced_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_REPLACED,
                directory_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_DIR_FSYNCED,
                publication_guard=publication_guard,

                self._path,
                state_bytes,
                temp_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_TEMP_FSYNCED,
                replaced_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_REPLACED,
                directory_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_DIR_FSYNCED,
                publication_guard=publication_guard,
            )

            if (
                self._snapshot(self._path) != old_state
                or self._snapshot(self._backup_path) != old_backup
            ):

    def _publish_bytes(

        data: bytes,
        *,
        temp_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        replaced_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        directory_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        create_only: bool = False,
        publication_guard: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        created = False

        def mark_created() -> None:
            nonlocal created
            created = True

        def checked_boundary(boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
            self._boundary(boundary)
            if publication_guard is not None:
                publication_guard()

        try:
            self._replace_bytes(
                target,
                data,
                create_only=create_only,
                temp_fsynced=lambda: checked_boundary(temp_boundary),
                target_created=mark_created if create_only else None,
            )
            checked_boundary(replaced_boundary)
            self._fsync_directory(target.parent)
            checked_boundary(directory_boundary)
        except BaseException as error:
            if created:
                try:
                    os.unlink(target.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get())
                except OSError as repair_error:
                    raise StateIOError(
                        f"cannot remove failed publication {target}: {repair_error}"
                    ) from repair_error
                self._fsync_directory(target.parent)

                raise StateIOError(f"cannot publish {target}: {error}") from error
            raise

    def _replace_bytes(
        self, target: Path, data: bytes, *, create_only: bool = False,
        temp_fsynced: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
        target_created: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        descriptor = -1
        temp_name = None
        directory = self._directory_fd.get()
        try:
            self._reject_aliased_artifact(target, "state publication target")
            temp_name = f".{self._path.name}.autopilot-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.tmp"
            descriptor = os.open(
                temp_name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                0o600, dir_fd=directory,
            )
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb", closefd=True) as stream:
                descriptor = -1
                stream.write(data)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            if temp_fsynced is not None:
                temp_fsynced()
            if create_only:
                try:
                    os.link(temp_name, target.name, src_dir_fd=directory,
                            dst_dir_fd=directory, follow_symlinks=False)
                except FileExistsError as error:
                    raise StateExistsError(f"state already exists: {target}") from error
                if target_created is not None:
                    target_created()
                os.unlink(temp_name, dir_fd=directory)
            else:
                os.replace(temp_name, target.name,
                           src_dir_fd=directory, dst_dir_fd=directory)
            temp_name = None
        finally:
            if descriptor >= 0:
                os.close(descriptor)
            if temp_name is not None:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temp_name, dir_fd=directory)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass

    def _repair(self, *, old_state: bytes, old_backup: bytes | None) -> None:
        self._replace_without_hook(self._path, old_state)
        if old_backup is None:
            try:
                if self._artifact_exists(self._backup_path):
                    os.unlink(self._backup_path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get())
            except OSError as error:
                raise StateIOError(
                    f"cannot remove repaired backup {self._backup_path}: {error}"
                ) from error
        else:
            self._replace_without_hook(self._backup_path, old_backup)
        self._fsync_directory(self._path.parent)

    def _replace_without_hook(self, target: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
        try:
            self._replace_bytes(target, data)
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot repair {target}: {error}") from error

    def _snapshot(self, path: Path) -> bytes | None:
        try:
            if not self._artifact_exists(path):
                return None
            return self._read_bytes(path)
        except StateIOError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot snapshot {path}: {error}") from error

    def _artifact_exists(self, path: Path) -> bool:
        self._reject_aliased_artifact(path, "state artifact")
        try:
            os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(
                f"cannot inspect state artifact {path}: {error}"
            ) from error
        return True

    def _reject_aliased_artifact(self, path: Path, label: str) -> None:
        try:
            artifact = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot inspect {label} {path}: {error}") from error
        if stat.S_ISLNK(artifact.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is a symlink: {path}")
        if not stat.S_ISREG(artifact.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is not a regular file: {path}")
        if artifact.st_nlink != 1:
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} has multiple hard links: {path}")

    def _verify_open_artifact(self, path: Path, descriptor: int, label: str) -> None:
        try:
            opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
            linked = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot verify {label} {path}: {error}") from error
        if stat.S_ISLNK(linked.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is a symlink: {path}")
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} changed while opening: {path}")
        if not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is not a regular file: {path}")
        if opened.st_nlink != 1 or linked.st_nlink != 1:
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} has multiple hard links: {path}")

    def _fsync_directory(self, directory: Path) -> None:
        try:
            os.fsync(self._directory_fd.get())
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno in {errno.EINVAL, errno.ENOTSUP, errno.EOPNOTSUPP}:
                raise DurabilityUnsupportedError(
                    f"directory fsync unsupported for {directory}: {error}"
                ) from error
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot fsync directory {directory}: {error}") from error

    def _boundary(self, boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
        if self._boundary_hook is not None:
            self._boundary_hook(boundary)
        self._verify_directory()

        return descriptor

    def _verify_directory(self) -> None:
        opened = os.fstat(self._directory_fd.get())
        linked = os.stat(self._path.parent)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino):
            raise StateIOError("state directory changed during operation")

    def _check_revision(self, state: State, expected: int | None) -> None:
        if expected is not None and (type(expected) is not int or expected < 0):
            raise StateError("expected revision must be a nonnegative integer")
        if expected is not None and state["revision"] != expected:
            raise RevisionConflictError(
                f"revision conflict: expected {expected}, found {state['revision']}"
            )

    def _read_bytes(self, path: Path) -> bytes:
        descriptor = -1
        try:
            self._reject_aliased_artifact(path, "state artifact")
            descriptor = os.open(
                path.name,
                os.O_RDONLY
                | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
                | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
                | getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0),
                dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(),
            )
            self._verify_open_artifact(path, descriptor, "state artifact")
            chunks: list[bytes] = []
            remaining = schema.MAX_STATE_BYTES + 1
            while remaining > 0:
                chunk = os.read(descriptor, min(remaining, 64 * 1024))
                if not chunk:
                    break
                chunks.append(chunk)
                remaining -= len(chunk)
            raw = b"".join(chunks)
        except OSError as error:
            detail = " is a symlink" if error.errno == errno.ELOOP else f": {error}"
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot read state {path}{detail}") from error
        finally:
            if descriptor >= 0:
                os.close(descriptor)
        if len(raw) > schema.MAX_STATE_BYTES:
            raise StateResourceLimitError(
                f"state exceeds {schema.MAX_STATE_BYTES} bytes: {path}"
            )
        return raw

    def _read_backup(self) -> bytes:
        try:
            return self._read_bytes(self._backup_path)
        except StateIOError as error:
            raise BackupError(
                f"cannot read backup {self._backup_path}: {error}"
            ) from error

    def _decode_state(self, raw: bytes) -> State:
        try:
            text = raw.decode("utf-8")
            value = schema.decode_json(text, source="state")
        except schema.ResourceLimitError as error:
            raise StateResourceLimitError(str(error)) from error
        except (
            UnicodeDecodeError,
            ValueError,
        ) as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"invalid state JSON: {error}") from error
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            version = value.get("schema_version")
            if (
                isinstance(version, int)
                and not isinstance(version, bool)
                and version > schema.SCHEMA_VERSION
            ):
                raise FutureSchemaError(
                    f"schema_version {version} is newer than {schema.SCHEMA_VERSION}"
                )
        return schema.validate_state(value)

    def _commit_pair(
        self,
        *,
        backup_bytes: bytes,
        state_bytes: bytes,
        old_state: bytes,
        old_backup: bytes | None,
        publication_guard: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            self._verify_directory()
            self._publish_bytes(
                self._backup_path,
                backup_bytes,
                temp_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_TEMP_FSYNCED,
                replaced_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_REPLACED,
                directory_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.BACKUP_DIR_FSYNCED,
                publication_guard=publication_guard,
            )
            self._publish_bytes(
                self._path,
                state_bytes,
                temp_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_TEMP_FSYNCED,
                replaced_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_REPLACED,
                directory_boundary=DurabilityBoundary.STATE_DIR_FSYNCED,
                publication_guard=publication_guard,
            )
        except BaseException:
            if (
                self._snapshot(self._path) != old_state
                or self._snapshot(self._backup_path) != old_backup
            ):
                self._repair(old_state=old_state, old_backup=old_backup)
            raise

    def _publish_bytes(
        self,
        target: Path,
        data: bytes,
        *,
        temp_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        replaced_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        directory_boundary: DurabilityBoundary,
        create_only: bool = False,
        publication_guard: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        created = False

        def mark_created() -> None:
            nonlocal created
            created = True

        def checked_boundary(boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
            self._boundary(boundary)
            if publication_guard is not None:
                publication_guard()

        try:
            self._replace_bytes(
                target,
                data,
                create_only=create_only,
                temp_fsynced=lambda: checked_boundary(temp_boundary),
                target_created=mark_created if create_only else None,
            )
            checked_boundary(replaced_boundary)
            self._fsync_directory(target.parent)
            checked_boundary(directory_boundary)
        except BaseException as error:
            if created:
                try:
                    os.unlink(target.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get())
                except OSError as repair_error:
                    raise StateIOError(
                        f"cannot remove failed publication {target}: {repair_error}"
                    ) from repair_error
                self._fsync_directory(target.parent)
            if isinstance(error, OSError):
                raise StateIOError(f"cannot publish {target}: {error}") from error
            raise

    def _replace_bytes(
        self, target: Path, data: bytes, *, create_only: bool = False,
        temp_fsynced: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
        target_created: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        descriptor = -1
        temp_name = None
        directory = self._directory_fd.get()
        try:
            self._reject_aliased_artifact(target, "state publication target")
            temp_name = f".{self._path.name}.autopilot-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.tmp"
            descriptor = os.open(
                temp_name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                0o600, dir_fd=directory,
            )
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb", closefd=True) as stream:
                descriptor = -1
                stream.write(data)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            if temp_fsynced is not None:
                temp_fsynced()
            if create_only:
                try:
                    os.link(temp_name, target.name, src_dir_fd=directory,
                            dst_dir_fd=directory, follow_symlinks=False)
                except FileExistsError as error:
                    raise StateExistsError(f"state already exists: {target}") from error
                if target_created is not None:
                    target_created()
                os.unlink(temp_name, dir_fd=directory)
            else:
                os.replace(temp_name, target.name,
                           src_dir_fd=directory, dst_dir_fd=directory)
            temp_name = None
        finally:
            if descriptor >= 0:
                os.close(descriptor)
            if temp_name is not None:
                try:
                    os.unlink(temp_name, dir_fd=directory)
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass

    def _repair(self, *, old_state: bytes, old_backup: bytes | None) -> None:
        self._replace_without_hook(self._path, old_state)
        if old_backup is None:
            try:
                if self._artifact_exists(self._backup_path):
                    os.unlink(self._backup_path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get())
            except OSError as error:
                raise StateIOError(
                    f"cannot remove repaired backup {self._backup_path}: {error}"
                ) from error
        else:
            self._replace_without_hook(self._backup_path, old_backup)
        self._fsync_directory(self._path.parent)

    def _replace_without_hook(self, target: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
        try:
            self._replace_bytes(target, data)
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot repair {target}: {error}") from error

    def _snapshot(self, path: Path) -> bytes | None:
        try:
            if not self._artifact_exists(path):
                return None
            return self._read_bytes(path)
        except StateIOError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot snapshot {path}: {error}") from error

    def _artifact_exists(self, path: Path) -> bool:
        self._reject_aliased_artifact(path, "state artifact")
        try:
            os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(
                f"cannot inspect state artifact {path}: {error}"
            ) from error
        return True

    def _reject_aliased_artifact(self, path: Path, label: str) -> None:
        try:
            artifact = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot inspect {label} {path}: {error}") from error
        if stat.S_ISLNK(artifact.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is a symlink: {path}")
        if not stat.S_ISREG(artifact.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is not a regular file: {path}")
        if artifact.st_nlink != 1:
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} has multiple hard links: {path}")

    def _verify_open_artifact(self, path: Path, descriptor: int, label: str) -> None:
        try:
            opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
            linked = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self._directory_fd.get(), follow_symlinks=False)
        except OSError as error:
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot verify {label} {path}: {error}") from error
        if stat.S_ISLNK(linked.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is a symlink: {path}")
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} changed while opening: {path}")
        if not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} is not a regular file: {path}")
        if opened.st_nlink != 1 or linked.st_nlink != 1:
            raise StateIOError(f"{label} has multiple hard links: {path}")

    def _fsync_directory(self, directory: Path) -> None:
        try:
            os.fsync(self._directory_fd.get())
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno in {errno.EINVAL, errno.ENOTSUP, errno.EOPNOTSUPP}:
                raise DurabilityUnsupportedError(
                    f"directory fsync unsupported for {directory}: {error}"
                ) from error
            raise StateIOError(f"cannot fsync directory {directory}: {error}") from error

    def _boundary(self, boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
        if self._boundary_hook is not None:
            self._boundary_hook(boundary)
        self._verify_directory()

"""Private credentials and durable, secret-free bootstrap intent recovery."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
import re
import secrets
import stat
from pathlib import Path

from . import schema
from .store import StateIOError, StateStore

CREDENTIAL_KEYS = {"actor_id", "project_id", "workflow_id", "role",
                   "lease_epoch", "native_session_id", "secret"}
INTENT_KEYS = {"version", "request", "request_digest", "old_revision",
               "old_state_digest", "old_actor", "candidate", "response",
               "receipt", "new_actor", "stage", "final", "credential_digest"}
INTENT_LIMIT = 33554432
NORMAL_STATE_LIMIT = 14680064
STAGING_FILE_LIMIT = 64
STAGING_BYTE_LIMIT = 16777216
# Controller-owned temporaries: intent and StateStore publication temps in the
# private directory, credential stages and rollback copies under actors.
PRIVATE_ARTIFACT = re.compile(r"\.(?:intent|state\.json\.autopilot)-[0-9a-f]{32}\.tmp")
ACTOR_ARTIFACT = re.compile(
    r"\.(?:(?:operator|owner)-[0-9a-f]{32}\.stage|operator-[0-9a-f]{32}\.rollback)"
)


class BindingError(ValueError):
    """The supplied credential does not authorize the request."""


def canonical(value: object) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def digest(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


class PrivateLayout:
    """Hold ancestor directory descriptors across inspection and publication."""

    def __init__(self, root: Path) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.private = root / ".autopilot" / "controller"
        self.actors = self.private / "actors"
        self.directories: dict[Path, int] = {}

    def __enter__(self) -> PrivateLayout:
        try:
            self.directory(self.root)
            for path in (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private, self.actors):
                descriptor = self.directory(path)
                if descriptor is not None and stat.S_IMODE(
                        os.fstat(descriptor).st_mode) != 0o700:
                    raise StateIOError("controller directory is not private")
            self.verify()
            for name in ("state.json", "state.json.bak", "state.json.lock"):
                path = self.private / name
                if self.exists(path):
                    self._regular(os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=self.directories[self.private],
                                          follow_symlinks=False), True)
            return self
        except BaseException:
            self.__exit__(None, None, None)
            raise

    def __exit__(self, *unused: object) -> None:
        for descriptor in reversed(list(self.directories.values())):
            os.close(descriptor)
        self.directories.clear()

    def directory(self, path: Path, *, create: bool = False) -> int | None:
        if path in self.directories:
            return self.directories[path]
        parent = None if path == Path("/") else self.directory(path.parent, create=create)
        if path != Path("/") and parent is None:
            return None
        name = str(path) if parent is None else path.name
        if create:
            try:
                os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=parent)
                if parent is not None:
                    os.fsync(parent)
            except FileExistsError:
                pass
        try:
            before = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return None
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(before.st_mode):
            raise StateIOError("unsafe directory")
        descriptor = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                             dir_fd=parent)
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino):
            os.close(descriptor)
            raise StateIOError("directory changed while opening")
        self.directories[path] = descriptor
        return descriptor

    def verify(self) -> None:
        for path, descriptor in self.directories.items():
            parent = self.directories.get(path.parent) if path != Path("/") else None
            linked = os.stat(str(path) if parent is None else path.name,
                             dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
            if (not stat.S_ISDIR(linked.st_mode) or
                    (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino)):
                raise StateIOError("directory changed during operation")
            if path in (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private, self.actors):
                if stat.S_IMODE(linked.st_mode) != 0o700:
                    raise StateIOError("controller directory is not private")

    def exists(self, path: Path) -> bool:
        parent = self.directory(path.parent)
        if parent is None:
            return False
        try:
            os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return False
        return True

    def read(self, path: Path, limit: int, *, private: bool = True) -> bytes:
        parent = self.directory(path.parent)
        if parent is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError
        self.verify()
        before = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        self._regular(before, private)
        descriptor = os.open(path.name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK,
                             dir_fd=parent)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
            opened = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            self._regular(opened, private)
            if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino):
                raise StateIOError("file changed while opening")
            raw = stream.read(limit + 1)
            linked = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
            self._regular(linked, private)
            if (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (linked.st_dev, linked.st_ino):
                raise StateIOError("file changed during reading")
        self.verify()
        if len(raw) > limit:
            raise StateIOError("file exceeds resource limit")
        return raw

    def inspect(self, path: Path) -> int:
        """Descriptor-check one private file without reading it; return its size."""
        parent = self.directories[path.parent]
        before = os.stat(path.name, dir_fd=parent, follow_symlinks=False)
        self._regular(before, True)
        descriptor = os.open(path.name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=parent)
        try:
            opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)
        self._regular(opened, True)
        if (before.st_dev, before.st_ino) != (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino):
            raise StateIOError("file changed while opening")
        return opened.st_size

    @staticmethod
    def _regular(info: os.stat_result, private: bool) -> None:
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1:
            raise StateIOError("unsafe regular file")
        if private and stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) != 0o600:
            raise StateIOError("file is not private")

    def prepare(self) -> None:
        # Inspect both ignores before creating anything, including the lock.
        if self.exists(self.private / "state.json.lock"):
            # Our bootstrap creates all three directories before the lock.
            # An incomplete layout with a lock is forensic, never repaired.
            if any(self.directory(path) is None for path in
                   (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private, self.actors)):
                raise StateIOError("incomplete private layout")
            self.verify()
            return
        try:
            self.check_ignores()
        except (StateIOError, OSError):
            # A concurrent bootstrap can acquire its lock after our check.
            # Defer ignore inspection to that lock without creating paths.
            if self.exists(self.private / "state.json.lock"):
                return self.prepare()
            raise
        for path in (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private, self.actors):
            self.directory(path, create=True)
        self.verify()
        # Establish the fixed inode with create-exclusive semantics before
        # concurrent StateStore opens add flock to that same inode.
        try:
            self.write_new(self.private / "state.json.lock", b"")
        except FileExistsError:
            pass

    def check_ignores(self) -> None:
        for parent in (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private):
            ignore = parent / ".gitignore"
            if self.exists(ignore) and self.read(ignore, 2) != b"*\n":
                raise StateIOError("incompatible private ignore")

    def prepare_ignores(self) -> None:
        self.check_ignores()
        for parent in (self.root / ".autopilot", self.private):
            ignore = parent / ".gitignore"
            if not self.exists(ignore):
                try:
                    self.write_new(ignore, b"*\n")
                except FileExistsError:
                    pass
            if self.read(ignore, 2) != b"*\n":
                raise StateIOError("incompatible private ignore")

    def write_new(self, path: Path, raw: bytes) -> None:
        self.verify()
        parent = self.directories[path.parent]
        descriptor = os.open(path.name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL |
                             os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600, dir_fd=parent)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        self.verify()
        os.fsync(parent)

    def publish(self, stage: Path, target: Path) -> None:
        self.verify()
        if self.exists(target):
            raise StateIOError("publication target already exists")
        os.replace(stage.name, target.name,
                   src_dir_fd=self.directories[stage.parent],
                   dst_dir_fd=self.directories[target.parent])
        self.verify()
        os.fsync(self.directories[target.parent])

    def remove(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.verify()
        if self.exists(path):
            self.read(path, INTENT_LIMIT)
            os.unlink(path.name, dir_fd=self.directories[path.parent])


def read_public(path: Path, limit: int = 16777216) -> bytes:
    """Read installed metadata without traversing directory or file symlinks."""
    with PrivateLayout(Path("/")) as layout:
        return layout.read(path, limit, private=False)


def admit_staging(layout: PrivateLayout, proposed: list[bytes]) -> None:
    """Refuse a staging set that, with retained orphans, exceeds either budget.

    Orphans are never deleted here; an unsafe or unreadable one refuses.
    """
    count, size = len(proposed), sum(len(raw) for raw in proposed)
    layout.verify()
    for parent, pattern in ((layout.private, PRIVATE_ARTIFACT), (layout.actors, ACTOR_ARTIFACT)):
        for name in os.listdir(layout.directories[parent]):
            if pattern.fullmatch(name):
                count += 1
                size += layout.inspect(parent / name)
    if count > STAGING_FILE_LIMIT or size > STAGING_BYTE_LIMIT:
        raise StateIOError("staging budget exhausted")


def credential_descriptor(raw: bytes) -> dict:
    value = schema.decode_json(raw.decode("utf-8"), source="credential")
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != CREDENTIAL_KEYS:
        raise BindingError("invalid credential")
    secret = value["secret"]
    if not isinstance(secret, str) or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}", secret) is None:
        raise BindingError("invalid credential")
    descriptor = {key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "secret"}
    descriptor["secret_digest"] = digest(secret.encode("utf-8"))
    schema._actor(descriptor)
    return descriptor


def authenticate(path: Path | None, descriptor: dict, layout: PrivateLayout) -> None:
    try:
        if path is None:
            raise BindingError("credential required")
        supplied = credential_descriptor(layout.read(path.absolute(), 65536))
        expected = dict(descriptor)
        supplied_digest = supplied.pop("secret_digest")
        expected_digest = expected.pop("secret_digest")
        if supplied != expected or not hmac.compare_digest(supplied_digest, expected_digest):
            raise BindingError("credential mismatch")
    except (OSError, StateIOError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise BindingError("credential rejected") from error


def verify_operator(layout: PrivateLayout, current: dict) -> None:
    descriptor = next((row for row in current["actors"].values()
                       if row["role"] == "operator"), None)
    if descriptor is None:
        raise StateIOError("current operator missing")
    try:
        authenticate(layout.actors / "operator.json", descriptor, layout)
    except BindingError as error:
        raise StateIOError("current operator credential unavailable") from error


def authenticate_receipt(path: Path | None, descriptor: dict, current: dict,
                         layout: PrivateLayout) -> None:
    try:
        authenticate(path, descriptor, layout)
        return
    except BindingError:
        active = current["actors"].get(descriptor["actor_id"])
        if (active is None or active["role"] != descriptor["role"]
                or active["lease_epoch"] < descriptor["lease_epoch"]):
            raise
    authenticate(path, active, layout)


def admit(candidate: dict, response: dict, *, emergency: bool = False) -> dict:
    candidate = schema.validate_state(candidate)
    stored = (json.dumps(candidate, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
              + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    if not emergency and (len(stored) > NORMAL_STATE_LIMIT
                          or len(candidate["receipts"]) > 4094):
        raise StateIOError("normal capacity exhausted")
    if len(canonical(response)) > 65536:
        raise StateIOError("response exceeds resource limit")
    return candidate


def prepare_bootstrap(request: dict, layout: PrivateLayout, response: dict) -> dict:
    workflow_id = response["result"]["workflow_id"]
    actor_id = response["result"]["actor_id"]
    credential = {"actor_id": actor_id, "project_id": request["project_id"],
                  "workflow_id": workflow_id, "role": "operator", "lease_epoch": 0,
                  "native_session_id": None, "secret": secrets.token_urlsafe(32)}
    raw = canonical(credential)
    descriptor = credential_descriptor(raw)
    receipt = {"request_digest": digest(canonical(request)),
               "authorizing_actor": descriptor, "response": response}
    candidate = schema.new_state(repo_root=layout.root, project_id=request["project_id"],
                                 workflow_id=workflow_id)
    candidate["actors"] = {actor_id: descriptor}
    candidate["receipts"] = {request["request_id"]: receipt}
    candidate = admit(candidate, response)
    intent = {"version": 1, "request": request, "request_digest": receipt["request_digest"],
              "old_revision": None, "old_state_digest": None, "old_actor": None,
              "candidate": candidate, "response": response, "receipt": receipt,
              "new_actor": descriptor, "stage": f".operator-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.stage",
              "final": "operator.json", "credential_digest": digest(raw)}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Export the pinnable controller contract bundle of an autopilot plugin root.

Writes <plugin-root>/contracts/controller-v1.json from plugin.json and the raw
bytes of the controller schema and fixtures. --check writes nothing and exits 1
when the bundle on disk is missing, not a regular file, or differs.
Self-contained stdlib script; it never reads live workflow state.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "plugins" / "autopilot"
TARGET = Path("contracts") / "controller-v1.json"
SCHEMA = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "workflow-v1.json"
FIXTURES = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "fixtures-v1.json"
# The export tests check these equal literal sets in the test and are a subset
# of what `controller/main.py --json contract` reports.
OPERATIONS = ["workflow.open", "owner.acquire", "owner.release", "owner.recover"]
CAPABILITIES = ["workflow.core.v1"]
LIMIT = 16777216


def checked(root: Path, relative: Path, regular: bool = True) -> Path:
    """root / relative with no symlink component; a regular file under LIMIT."""
    path = root
    for part in relative.parts:
        path = path / part
        info = path.lstat()
        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
            raise ValueError(f"{path} is a symlink")
    if regular and not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_size < LIMIT):
        raise ValueError(f"{path} is not a regular file under {LIMIT} bytes")
    return path


def build_bundle(root: Path) -> bytes:
    manifest = json.loads(checked(root, Path("plugin.json")).read_bytes())
    version = manifest.get("version") if isinstance(manifest, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(version, str) or not version:
        raise ValueError("plugin.json version must be a non-empty string")
    bundle = {
        "protocol_major": 1,
        "package_version": version,
        "schema_digest": hashlib.sha256(checked(root, SCHEMA).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "fixture_digest": hashlib.sha256(
            checked(root, FIXTURES).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest(),
        "operations": OPERATIONS,
        "capabilities": CAPABILITIES,
    }
    return (json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def matches(target: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
    try:
        info = target.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return False
    return stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and target.read_bytes() == expected


def write_atomic(target: Path, data: bytes, mode: int) -> None:
    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=target.parent, prefix=f".{target.name}.")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
            os.fchmod(handle.fileno(), mode)
            handle.write(data)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        os.replace(temp, target)
    except BaseException:
        os.unlink(temp)
        raise


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--plugin-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ROOT)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    root = args.plugin_root
    try:
        data = build_bundle(root)
        checked(root, TARGET.parent, regular=False)
        if args.check:
            if matches(root / TARGET, data):
                return 0
            print(f"error: {root / TARGET} is stale or missing", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        # Same permission bits as the sibling contracts, not mkstemp's 0600.
        mode = stat.S_IMODE((root / SCHEMA).stat().st_mode) & 0o666
        write_atomic(root / TARGET, data, mode)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

    digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    row = asset_row(path, digest, dict(cited))
    row["adaptation_reason"] = (
        "Newly authored AP00018 controller asset; no pinned source asset or "

        "it certifies no host execution."
    )
    owner = owner_row(path)
    owner["delivery_prd"] = "00018"

            "expected_outcome": "The packaged AP00018 controller asset exists at "

def apply_successor(result: dict, root: Path, successor: dict, artifact: dict) -> None:
    revision = successor["package_revision"]
    cited = {"status": "passed", **artifact, "tested_package_revision": revision}
    listed = set(successor["paths"])
    if CONTROLLER_CONTRACT in listed:
        path = CONTROLLER_CONTRACT
        digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row = asset_row(path, digest, dict(cited))
        row["adaptation_reason"] = (
            "Newly authored AP00018 controller contract bundle; no pinned source "
            "asset or source sections. Delivery evidence records packaged bytes, "
            "not host certification."
        )
        row["acceptance_cases"][0]["expected_outcome"] = (
            "The packaged controller contract bundle exists at the recorded digest; "
            "it certifies no host execution."
        )
        owner = owner_row(path)
        owner["delivery_prd"] = "00018"
        owner["acceptance_cases"] = [
            {
                "case_id": f"authored-{path}",
                "expected_outcome": "The packaged AP00018 controller contract bundle "
                "exists at the recorded digest.",
            }
        ]
        upsert(result["assets"], "destination_path", row)
        upsert(result["authored_file_owners"], "path", owner)
    known = {row["destination_path"] for row in result["assets"]}
    for path in sorted(listed - known):
        if path.startswith(CONTROLLER_PREFIXES):
            register_controller_asset(result, root, path, cited)
    for row in result["assets"]:
        path = row["destination_path"]
        if path not in listed:
            continue
        sha = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row["destination_blob_sha256"] = sha
        row["evidence"] = dict(cited)
        if path in REFRESHED[1:]:
            row["evidence"].update(artifact_id=path, artifact_sha256=sha)

    assets: list[dict],
    root: Path,
    evidence: dict,
    unavailable: dict,
    revision: str | None,
) -> None:
    for row in assets:
        path = row["destination_path"]
        if path not in REFRESHED:
            continue
        sha = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row["destination_blob_sha256"] = sha
        if path == REFRESHED[0]:
            row["evidence"] = dict(evidence)
        elif revision is None:
            row["evidence"] = dict(unavailable)
        else:
            row["evidence"] = {
                "status": "passed",
                "artifact_id": path,
                "artifact_sha256": sha,
                "tested_package_revision": revision,
            }


def apply(
    document: dict,
    receipts: dict | None,
    root: Path = ROOT,
    artifact: dict | None = None,
    successor: dict | None = None,
    successor_artifact: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if "helper_dispositions" in document:
        validate(document["helper_dispositions"], document)
    if receipts is not None:
        validate_receipts(receipts)
    has_successor = successor is not None or successor_artifact is not None
    if has_successor:
        validate_successor_receipts(successor, artifact)
    result = copy.deepcopy(document)
    result["helper_dispositions"] = build_dispositions(document)
    unavailable = {
        "status": "unavailable",
        "artifact_id": None,
        "artifact_sha256": None,
        "tested_package_revision": None,
    }
    evidence = dict(unavailable)
    if receipts is not None and artifact is not None:
        evidence.update(status="passed", **artifact)
    for path in HELPER_PATHS:
        digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        upsert(
            result["assets"],
            "destination_path",
            asset_row(path, digest, dict(evidence)),
        )
        upsert(result["authored_file_owners"], "path", owner_row(path))
    revision = (receipts or {}).get("package_revision")
    refresh_shared_evidence(result["assets"], root, evidence, unavailable, revision)
    if has_successor:
        apply_successor(result, root, successor, successor_artifact)
    refresh_ap00014_digests(result["assets"], root)
    return result


def write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(temporary, path.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def load_artifact(
    given: Path | None, default: str, root: Path
) -> tuple[object, dict | None]:
    if given is None and os.path.isfile(root / default):
        given = root / default
    if given is None:
        return None, None
    given = given.resolve()
    data = given.read_bytes()
    return json.loads(data), {
        "artifact_id": given.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
        "artifact_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
    }


def run(arguments: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    path = arguments.map.resolve()
    root = (arguments.root or path.parents[2]).resolve()
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    receipts, artifact = load_artifact(arguments.receipts, DEFAULT_RECEIPTS, root)
    successor, successor_artifact = load_artifact(
        arguments.successor_receipts, DEFAULT_SUCCESSOR_RECEIPTS, root
    )
    rendered = encode(
        apply(
            json.loads(raw),
            receipts,
            root,
            artifact,
            successor=successor,
            successor_artifact=successor_artifact,
        )
    )
    if arguments.check:
        if rendered != raw:
            print(
                f"{path} is not the generated helper map; rerun without --check",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        return 0
    if rendered != raw:
        write_atomically(path, rendered)
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--map", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--root", type=Path, help="Repository root; defaults to the map's repo root"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--receipts",
        type=Path,
        help="Coordinator-authored task receipts JSON; defaults to "
        f"ROOT/{DEFAULT_RECEIPTS} when that file exists",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--successor-receipts",
        type=Path,
        help="AP00018 successor receipts JSON; defaults to "
        f"ROOT/{DEFAULT_SUCCESSOR_RECEIPTS} when that file exists",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check", action="store_true", help="Exit 0 only if the map is generated"
    )
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        return run(arguments)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
        print(f"update_helper_map failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

            return
    rows.append(row)


def refresh_ap00014_digests(assets: list[dict], root: Path) -> None:
    ap00014 = set(AP00014_DIGESTED)
    for row in assets:
        if row["destination_path"] in ap00014:
            row["destination_blob_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
                (root / row["destination_path"]).read_bytes()
            ).hexdigest()


def register_controller_asset(result: dict, root: Path, path: str, cited: dict) -> None:
    digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    row = asset_row(path, digest, dict(cited))
    row["adaptation_reason"] = (
        "Newly authored AP00018 controller asset; no pinned source asset or "
        "source sections. Delivery evidence records packaged bytes, not host "
        "certification."
    )
    row["acceptance_cases"][0]["expected_outcome"] = (
        "The packaged AP00018 controller asset exists at the recorded digest; "
        "it certifies no host execution."
    )
    owner = owner_row(path)
    owner["delivery_prd"] = "00018"
    owner["acceptance_cases"] = [
        {
            "case_id": f"authored-{path}",
            "expected_outcome": "The packaged AP00018 controller asset exists at "
            "the recorded digest.",
        }
    ]
    upsert(result["assets"], "destination_path", row)
    upsert(result["authored_file_owners"], "path", owner)


def apply_successor(result: dict, root: Path, successor: dict, artifact: dict) -> None:
    revision = successor["package_revision"]
    cited = {"status": "passed", **artifact, "tested_package_revision": revision}
    listed = set(successor["paths"])
    if CONTROLLER_CONTRACT in listed:
        path = CONTROLLER_CONTRACT
        digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row = asset_row(path, digest, dict(cited))
        row["adaptation_reason"] = (
            "Newly authored AP00018 controller contract bundle; no pinned source "
            "asset or source sections. Delivery evidence records packaged bytes, "
            "not host certification."
        )
        row["acceptance_cases"][0]["expected_outcome"] = (
            "The packaged controller contract bundle exists at the recorded digest; "
            "it certifies no host execution."
        )
        owner = owner_row(path)
        owner["delivery_prd"] = "00018"
        owner["acceptance_cases"] = [
            {
                "case_id": f"authored-{path}",
                "expected_outcome": "The packaged AP00018 controller contract bundle "
                "exists at the recorded digest.",
            }
        ]
        upsert(result["assets"], "destination_path", row)
        upsert(result["authored_file_owners"], "path", owner)
    known = {row["destination_path"] for row in result["assets"]}
    for path in sorted(listed - known):
        if path.startswith(CONTROLLER_PREFIXES):
            register_controller_asset(result, root, path, cited)
    for row in result["assets"]:
        path = row["destination_path"]
        if path not in listed:
            continue
        sha = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row["destination_blob_sha256"] = sha
        row["evidence"] = dict(cited)
        if path in REFRESHED[1:]:
            row["evidence"].update(artifact_id=path, artifact_sha256=sha)


def refresh_shared_evidence(
    assets: list[dict],
    root: Path,
    evidence: dict,
    unavailable: dict,
    revision: str | None,
) -> None:
    for row in assets:
        path = row["destination_path"]
        if path not in REFRESHED:
            continue
        sha = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        row["destination_blob_sha256"] = sha
        if path == REFRESHED[0]:
            row["evidence"] = dict(evidence)
        elif revision is None:
            row["evidence"] = dict(unavailable)
        else:
            row["evidence"] = {
                "status": "passed",
                "artifact_id": path,
                "artifact_sha256": sha,
                "tested_package_revision": revision,
            }


def apply(
    document: dict,
    receipts: dict | None,
    root: Path = ROOT,
    artifact: dict | None = None,
    successor: dict | None = None,
    successor_artifact: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if "helper_dispositions" in document:
        validate(document["helper_dispositions"], document)
    if receipts is not None:
        validate_receipts(receipts)
    has_successor = successor is not None or successor_artifact is not None
    if has_successor:
        validate_successor_receipts(successor, artifact)
    result = copy.deepcopy(document)
    result["helper_dispositions"] = build_dispositions(document)
    unavailable = {
        "status": "unavailable",
        "artifact_id": None,
        "artifact_sha256": None,
        "tested_package_revision": None,
    }
    evidence = dict(unavailable)
    if receipts is not None and artifact is not None:
        evidence.update(status="passed", **artifact)
    for path in HELPER_PATHS:
        digest = hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        upsert(
            result["assets"],
            "destination_path",
            asset_row(path, digest, dict(evidence)),
        )
        upsert(result["authored_file_owners"], "path", owner_row(path))
    revision = (receipts or {}).get("package_revision")
    refresh_shared_evidence(result["assets"], root, evidence, unavailable, revision)
    if has_successor:
        apply_successor(result, root, successor, successor_artifact)
    refresh_ap00014_digests(result["assets"], root)
    return result


def write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=".tmp")
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.chmod(temporary, path.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)


def load_artifact(
    given: Path | None, default: str, root: Path
) -> tuple[object, dict | None]:
    if given is None and os.path.isfile(root / default):
        given = root / default
    if given is None:
        return None, None
    given = given.resolve()
    data = given.read_bytes()
    return json.loads(data), {
        "artifact_id": given.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
        "artifact_sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
    }


def run(arguments: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    path = arguments.map.resolve()
    root = (arguments.root or path.parents[2]).resolve()
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    receipts, artifact = load_artifact(arguments.receipts, DEFAULT_RECEIPTS, root)
    successor, successor_artifact = load_artifact(
        arguments.successor_receipts, DEFAULT_SUCCESSOR_RECEIPTS, root
    )
    rendered = encode(
        apply(
            json.loads(raw),
            receipts,
            root,
            artifact,
            successor=successor,
            successor_artifact=successor_artifact,
        )
    )
    if arguments.check:
        if rendered != raw:
            print(
                f"{path} is not the generated helper map; rerun without --check",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 1
        return 0
    if rendered != raw:
        write_atomically(path, rendered)
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--map", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--root", type=Path, help="Repository root; defaults to the map's repo root"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--receipts",
        type=Path,
        help="Coordinator-authored task receipts JSON; defaults to "
        f"ROOT/{DEFAULT_RECEIPTS} when that file exists",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--successor-receipts",
        type=Path,
        help="AP00018 successor receipts JSON; defaults to "
        f"ROOT/{DEFAULT_SUCCESSOR_RECEIPTS} when that file exists",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check", action="store_true", help="Exit 0 only if the map is generated"
    )
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        return run(arguments)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError) as error:
        print(f"update_helper_map failed: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

<file name="/Users/bob/git/src/github.com/buvis/agent-plugins/plugins/autopilot/README.md" language="markdown" >
<content>
`tools/autopilot/source-map.json` records each helper function and regression in
`helper_dispositions`. Controller-owned functions stay controller-only, and no
existing regression owner is reassigned.

This package is not published to any marketplace. No installation is supported
yet; the historical Install and Update sections describe the source plugin.
Real-host evidence is unavailable: the helpers are tested in a sandbox only, and
no host profile is certified.

## Controller contract bundle

`contracts/controller-v1.json` pins the controller protocol, package version,
schema and fixture digests, operations and capabilities. Maintainers regenerate
it in a repository checkout with the unshipped exporter
`tools/autopilot/export-controller-contract.py`, whose check mode verifies it.
Its `sha256sum` from the repository root is:

```text
7bef27adaee3a786f6d0ce1e91176492d1012e67eae6ab2500e31150136eaa98  plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller-v1.json
```

The installed controller argv is:

```json
["python3", "<installed-plugin-root>/controller/main.py"]
```

### Runtime and commands

The controller needs Python 3.12 or newer. It uses the standard library only.
Run it with the installed argv and one of these commands:

```text
--json contract
--json snapshot --project-root PATH
--json apply --project-root PATH --request FILE [--actor-file PATH]
```

Exit code 0 means success. Exit code 1 means a structured rejection. Exit code
2 means argument misuse. Callers must bound execution time.

### Implemented operations

The controller implements four operations: `workflow.open`, `owner.acquire`,
`owner.release` and `owner.recover`. It advertises one capability,
`workflow.core.v1`. All later operation families are unavailable until
implemented: policy, prd, task, lane, job, review, custody, verification,
phase, artifact and records. A request for one of them returns
`missing_capability` and writes nothing.

### Private store

The controller keeps its state in `<project-root>/.autopilot/controller/`, a
private directory with mode 0700. It holds `state.json`, `state.json.bak`,
`state.json.lock` and `actors/`. Credentials are files with mode 0600. Their
contents never appear in responses or logs.

### Receipt capacity

Normal receipt admission stops at 4094 entries. Two more slots are reserved
for `owner.release` and `owner.recover`. These may clear an active owner at
saturation, but they never acquire a new one. At 4096 entries the workflow is
sealed against all new mutations. Exact receipt retrieval and `snapshot` stay
available.

### Leave a sealed workflow

No archival or state removal runs automatically. Follow these steps by hand,
in order:

1. Finish or reconcile jobs. This controller supports no jobs yet.
2. Release or recover ownership with `owner.release` or `owner.recover`. These
   use the reserve capacity.
3. Run `snapshot` and verify that the owner is null.
4. Copy the entire private controller directory to a private offline archive.
   Verify every file hash.
5. Rename the original private directory into a sibling private archive named
   by the workflow ID.
6. Open a new workflow with `workflow.open` at the fixed empty controller path.

Never delete the archive. Archived state, credentials, receipts and schema stay
replayable. To replay them, take the new workflow offline and place the
original directory back at its original project binding. Never merge
identities.

### Bounded orphans

A crash can leave controller-owned staging, rollback and temporary files. These
are credential `.stage` and `.rollback` files under `actors/`, plus
`.intent-*.tmp` files and state publication `.state.json.autopilot-*.tmp` files
in the private directory. The controller limits them to 64 files and 16777216
bytes in total. It refuses a bootstrap or owner mutation with
`recovery_required`, and changes nothing, when the full proposal would exceed
either limit. It does the same when it finds an unsafe or unreadable owned
artifact. The controller never deletes an orphan.

The admitted proposal leaves out the transient state publication temporaries.
A crash at a publication boundary can therefore keep up to two more
temporaries, each up to the size of the state. The next mutation then refuses.

### Recover from orphans

Archive-based recovery requires the operator to take the workflow offline,
retain all bytes, and restore the verified consistent state and credentials
before retry. Follow these steps in order:

1. Stop all callers.
2. Copy the private directory to a private offline archive. Verify every file
   hash.
3. Move only the identified orphan files into that archive. Never delete them.
</content>
</file>
